### Health Analytics with R · Module 04: Machine Learning for Clinical Prediction
***
**Learning objectives**
- Adapt the ML pipeline for three distinct clinical prediction tasks
- Sepsis early warning: high-recall binary classifier with alert threshold
- ICU LOS forecasting: regression with GBM + confidence intervals
- 30-day readmission scoring: probability-calibrated risk tier model
- Compare model architectures, evaluation metrics, and deployment considerations

**Estimated time:** 3 hours | **Level:** Advanced | **Libraries:** `tidymodels`, `xgboost`, `DALEX`, `ggplot2`

## 1. Setup


::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
library(tidyverse)
library(tidymodels)
library(xgboost)
library(ranger)
library(patchwork)
tidymodels_prefer()
set.seed(42)

mod04_dir <- file.path(tempdir(), "mod04")
dir.create(mod04_dir, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)
theme_set(
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
    theme(
      plot.background  = element_rect(fill = "white", colour = NA),
      panel.background = element_rect(fill = "white", colour = NA),
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
    )
)
col_blue <- "#2563EB"; col_red <- "#DC2626"; col_green <- "#16A34A"
col_gold <- "#D97706"; col_navy <- "#1E3A8A"
auc_prob   <- function(y, p) yardstick::roc_auc_vec(factor(y, levels = c(0, 1)), p, event_level = "second")
ap_prob    <- function(y, p) yardstick::pr_auc_vec(factor(y, levels = c(0, 1)), p, event_level = "second")
brier_prob <- function(y, p) mean((p - y)^2)

set.seed(42); N <- 4000
sig <- function(x) 1 / (1 + exp(-x))
clip <- function(x, lo, hi) pmin(pmax(x, lo), hi)
b <- matrix(rnorm(N * 5), ncol = 5); set.seed(99)

# Patient features
age <- as.integer(clip(rnorm(N, 58, 18), 18, 95))
sex <- sample(c("M", "F"), N, replace = TRUE, prob = c(0.48, 0.52))
diabetes <- rbinom(N, 1, sig(0.6 * b[, 1] - 0.5))
hf <- rbinom(N, 1, sig(0.4 * b[, 2] - 1.2))
copd <- rbinom(N, 1, sig(0.5 * b[, 3] - 1.0))
ckd <- rbinom(N, 1, sig(0.5 * b[, 1] + 0.6 * diabetes - 1.2))
immunocomp <- rbinom(N, 1, sig(0.3 * b[, 5] - 1.5))

# Vital signs
set.seed(21)
temp <- round(clip(rnorm(N, 37.2 + 0.8 * immunocomp, 0.8), 34, 42), 1)
hr   <- round(clip(rnorm(N, 85 + 15 * hf + 10 * immunocomp, 18), 40, 180), 0)
sbp  <- round(clip(rnorm(N, 125 - 10 * ckd, 22), 60, 200), 0)
resp <- round(clip(rnorm(N, 18 + 4 * copd + 2 * immunocomp, 4), 8, 40), 0)
wbc  <- round(clip(rgamma(N, shape = 4 + 3 * immunocomp, scale = 2), 0.5, 40), 1)
lactate <- round(clip(rgamma(N, shape = 1.5 + 2 * immunocomp, scale = 0.8), 0.5, 15), 2)
creatinine <- round(clip(rgamma(N, shape = 1.6 + 0.8 * hf + 0.5 * ckd, scale = 0.6), 0.4, 12), 2)
n_comorb <- diabetes + hf + copd + ckd

# ── OUTCOME 1: Sepsis (high-recall binary) ────────────────────────────────────
sepsis_logit <- (-4.0 + 0.8 * immunocomp + 0.5 * as.integer(temp > 38.5) +
                   0.4 * as.integer(hr > 100) + 0.6 * as.integer(lactate > 2.0) +
                   0.5 * as.integer(wbc > 12) + 0.3 * as.integer(sbp < 90) +
                   0.3 * as.integer(resp > 22) + rnorm(N, 0, 0.3))
sepsis <- rbinom(N, 1, sig(sepsis_logit))

# ── OUTCOME 2: ICU LOS (regression) ──────────────────────────────────────────
icu_los <- round(clip(2.0 + 1.5 * sepsis + 1.2 * hf + 0.8 * ckd + 0.5 * copd +
                        0.04 * (age - 58) + 0.8 * as.integer(lactate > 2) +
                        0.5 * as.integer(sbp < 90) + rgamma(N, shape = 1.5, scale = 1.2),
                      1, 30), 1)

# ── OUTCOME 3: 30-day readmission (calibrated probability) ───────────────────
logit_re <- (-3.2 + 0.6 * hf + 0.5 * diabetes + 0.5 * ckd + 0.3 * copd +
               0.02 * (age - 58) / 15 + 0.3 * as.integer(icu_los > 7) +
               0.5 * hf * diabetes + rnorm(N, 0, 0.25))
readmitted <- rbinom(N, 1, sig(logit_re))

df <- tibble(
  age, sex, diabetes, hf, copd, ckd, immunocomp, n_comorb,
  temp, hr, sbp, resp, wbc, lactate, creatinine,
  sepsis, icu_los, readmitted
)
cat(sprintf("Dataset: %d x %d\n", nrow(df), ncol(df)))
```

## 2. Model 1 — Sepsis Early Warning (High-Recall Classifier)


::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
VITALS <- c("temp", "hr", "sbp", "resp", "wbc", "lactate", "creatinine", "age")
COMORB <- c("diabetes", "hf", "copd", "ckd", "immunocomp", "n_comorb")
SEPSIS_FEATURES <- c(VITALS, COMORB)

set.seed(42)
df_s <- df %>%
  select(all_of(c(SEPSIS_FEATURES, "sepsis"))) %>%
  mutate(sepsis = factor(sepsis, levels = c(0, 1)))
sp_s <- initial_split(df_s, prop = 0.80, strata = sepsis)
Xs_tr <- training(sp_s); Xs_te <- testing(sp_s)
ys_tr <- as.integer(as.character(Xs_tr$sepsis))
ys_te <- as.integer(as.character(Xs_te$sepsis))

rec_s <- recipe(sepsis ~ ., data = Xs_tr) %>%
  step_impute_median(all_numeric_predictors()) %>%
  step_normalize(all_numeric_predictors())
pre_s <- prep(rec_s, training = Xs_tr)
Xstr <- as.matrix(bake(pre_s, new_data = Xs_tr) %>% select(-sepsis))
Xste <- as.matrix(bake(pre_s, new_data = Xs_te) %>% select(-sepsis))

# Use high recall objective: scale_pos_weight prioritises catching sepsis cases
gb_sepsis <- xgboost(
  data = Xstr, label = factor(ys_tr, levels = c(0, 1)), nrounds = 200, max_depth = 4, eta = 0.05,
  subsample = 0.8, objective = "binary:logistic", verbose = 0
)
```

```{.r .cell-code}
# Choose high-sensitivity threshold (clinical: missing sepsis is costly)
roc_s <- pROC::roc(ys_te, prob_sepsis, quiet = TRUE)
tpr <- roc_s$sensitivities
fpr <- 1 - roc_s$specificities
thrs <- roc_s$thresholds
thrs[is.infinite(thrs)] <- ifelse(thrs[is.infinite(thrs)] > 0, 1, 0)
sens_target <- 0.90   # want to catch 90% of sepsis cases
idx90 <- which(tpr >= sens_target)
thr_highsens <- if (length(idx90)) thrs[idx90[1]] else 0.5
y_pred_s <- as.integer(prob_sepsis >= thr_highsens)
tp <- sum(y_pred_s == 1 & ys_te == 1); fp <- sum(y_pred_s == 1 & ys_te == 0)
tn <- sum(y_pred_s == 0 & ys_te == 0); fn <- sum(y_pred_s == 0 & ys_te == 1)
cat(sprintf("At threshold=%.3f (targeting 90%% sensitivity):\n", thr_highsens))
```

## 3. Model 2 — ICU Length-of-Stay Forecasting (Regression)


::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
LOS_FEATURES <- c(VITALS, COMORB, "sepsis")
set.seed(42)
df_l <- df %>% select(all_of(c(LOS_FEATURES, "icu_los")))
sp_l <- initial_split(df_l, prop = 0.80)
Xl_tr <- training(sp_l); Xl_te <- testing(sp_l)
yl_tr <- Xl_tr$icu_los; yl_te <- Xl_te$icu_los

rec_l <- recipe(icu_los ~ ., data = Xl_tr) %>%
  step_impute_median(all_numeric_predictors()) %>%
  step_normalize(all_numeric_predictors())
pre_l <- prep(rec_l, training = Xl_tr)
Xltr <- as.matrix(bake(pre_l, new_data = Xl_tr) %>% select(-icu_los))
Xlte <- as.matrix(bake(pre_l, new_data = Xl_te) %>% select(-icu_los))

gbr <- xgboost(
  data = Xltr, label = yl_tr, nrounds = 200, max_depth = 4, eta = 0.05,
  subsample = 0.8, objective = "reg:squarederror", verbose = 0
)
```

```{.r .cell-code}
# Approximate prediction intervals via quantile estimation

coverage <- mean(yl_te >= pi_lo & yl_te <= pi_hi)
cat(sprintf("Naive PI coverage (±1.96σ): %.1f%% (target 95%%)\n", coverage * 100))
```

## 4. Model 3 — 30-Day Readmission Risk Score (Calibrated)


::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
RE_FEATURES <- c(VITALS, COMORB, "icu_los")
set.seed(42)
df_r <- df %>%
  select(all_of(c(RE_FEATURES, "readmitted"))) %>%
  mutate(readmitted = factor(readmitted, levels = c(0, 1)))
sp_r <- initial_split(df_r, prop = 0.80, strata = readmitted)
Xr_tr_all <- training(sp_r); Xr_te <- testing(sp_r)
sp_cal <- initial_split(Xr_tr_all, prop = 0.80, strata = readmitted)
Xr_tr2 <- training(sp_cal); Xr_cal <- testing(sp_cal)
yr_tr2 <- as.integer(as.character(Xr_tr2$readmitted))
yr_cal  <- as.integer(as.character(Xr_cal$readmitted))
yr_te   <- as.integer(as.character(Xr_te$readmitted))

rec_r <- recipe(readmitted ~ ., data = Xr_tr2) %>%
  step_impute_median(all_numeric_predictors()) %>%
  step_normalize(all_numeric_predictors())
pre_r <- prep(rec_r, training = Xr_tr2)
Xrtr  <- as.matrix(bake(pre_r, new_data = Xr_tr2) %>% select(-readmitted))
Xrcal <- as.matrix(bake(pre_r, new_data = Xr_cal) %>% select(-readmitted))
Xrte  <- as.matrix(bake(pre_r, new_data = Xr_te)  %>% select(-readmitted))

gb_re <- xgboost(
  data = Xrtr, label = factor(yr_tr2, levels = c(0, 1)), nrounds = 200, max_depth = 4, eta = 0.05,
  subsample = 0.8, objective = "binary:logistic", verbose = 0
)
```

```{.r .cell-code}
# Platt recalibration
prob_cal_raw <- predict(gb_re, Xrcal)
platt <- glm(y ~ p, data = tibble(y = yr_cal, p = prob_cal_raw), family = binomial)

auc_re   <- auc_prob(yr_te, prob_re_cal)
brier_re <- brier_prob(yr_te, prob_re_cal)
cat(sprintf("Readmission model: AUC=%.4f | Brier=%.4f\n", auc_re, brier_re))
```

```{.r .cell-code}
  mutate(tier = cut(prob, c(0, 0.10, 0.20, 0.35, 1.0),
```

## 5. Three-Model Deployment Summary


::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
pr_s <- yardstick::pr_curve(
  tibble(truth = factor(ys_te, levels = c(0, 1)), .pred = prob_sepsis),
  truth, .pred, event_level = "second"
)
p1 <- ggplot(pr_s, aes(recall, precision)) +
  geom_path(colour = col_red, linewidth = 1) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = mean(ys_te), colour = "grey50", linetype = "dashed") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0.90, colour = col_green, linetype = "dotted") +
  labs(x = "Recall", y = "Precision",
       title = sprintf("Model 1: Sepsis\n(Precision-Recall, AP=%.3f)", ap_s))

los_bins <- cut(yl_te, c(0, 3, 7, 14, 30), labels = c("1-3d", "4-7d", "8-14d", ">14d"))
mae_by_bin <- tibble(bin = los_bins, actual = yl_te, pred = pred_los) %>%
  group_by(bin) %>%
  summarise(mae = mean(abs(actual - pred)), .groups = "drop")
p2 <- ggplot(mae_by_bin, aes(bin, mae, fill = bin)) +
  geom_col(alpha = 0.85, show.legend = FALSE) +
  geom_text(aes(label = sprintf("%.1fd", mae)), vjust = -0.3, size = 3) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c(col_blue, col_green, col_gold, col_red)) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "MAE (days)",
       title = sprintf("Model 2: ICU LOS\nMAE by LOS stratum (overall=%.2fd)", mae))

calib_bins <- function(y, p, n_bins = 10) {
  tibble(y = y, p = p) %>%
    mutate(bin = ntile(p, n_bins)) %>%
    group_by(bin) %>%
    summarise(mean_pred = mean(p), frac_pos = mean(y), .groups = "drop")
}
cal <- bind_rows(
  calib_bins(yr_te, prob_re_raw) %>% mutate(method = "Uncalibrated"),
  calib_bins(yr_te, prob_re_cal) %>% mutate(method = sprintf("Platt calibrated (Brier=%.3f)", brier_re))
)
p3 <- ggplot(cal, aes(mean_pred, frac_pos, colour = method)) +
  geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0, linetype = "dashed") +
  geom_point(size = 2) + geom_line() +
  scale_colour_manual(values = c("Uncalibrated" = "#93C5FD",
                                 setNames(col_navy, sprintf("Platt calibrated (Brier=%.3f)", brier_re)))) +
  labs(x = "Mean predicted", y = "Fraction positives", colour = NULL,
       title = "Model 3: Readmission\nCalibration (before/after Platt)") +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom")

p1 + p2 + p3 + plot_annotation(title = "Three Clinical Prediction Models — Deployment Summary")
```

```{.r .cell-code}
# Exercise 5 — patient dashboard
patient_risk_dashboard <- function(patient_row) {
  # Return sepsis alert, expected LOS, readmission tier for one patient.
  Xs <- as.matrix(bake(pre_s, new_data = as_tibble(patient_row[SEPSIS_FEATURES])) %>%
                    select(-any_of("sepsis")))
  Xl <- as.matrix(bake(pre_l, new_data = as_tibble(patient_row[LOS_FEATURES])) %>%
                    select(-any_of("icu_los")))
  Xr <- as.matrix(bake(pre_r, new_data = as_tibble(patient_row[RE_FEATURES])) %>%
                    select(-any_of("readmitted")))
  p_sepsis <- predict(gb_sepsis, Xs)
  p_los    <- predict(gbr, Xl)
  p_re_raw <- predict(gb_re, Xr)
  p_re_cal <- as.numeric(predict(platt, newdata = tibble(p = p_re_raw), type = "response"))
  tier <- dplyr::case_when(
    p_re_cal < 0.10 ~ "Low",
    p_re_cal < 0.20 ~ "Moderate",
    p_re_cal < 0.35 ~ "High",
    TRUE ~ "Very high"
  )
  list(sepsis_alert = p_sepsis >= thr_highsens, sepsis_prob = round(p_sepsis, 3),
       expected_los = round(p_los, 1), readmit_prob = round(p_re_cal, 3),
       readmit_tier = tier)
}

sample_pt <- df[101, ]
dashboard <- patient_risk_dashboard(sample_pt)
cat("Patient Risk Dashboard\n")
```
